title: World Simulation with Video Foundation Models for Physical AI (Cosmos-Predict2.5)
key_claim: Cosmos-Predict2.5 is trained on 200M curated video clips with reinforcement-learning-based post-training, unifying Text2World, Image2World and Video2World generation in a single model for synthetic data generation, policy evaluation and closed-loop simulation for robotics and autonomous systems.
notes: v2 of arXiv 2511.00062 published 24 Feb 2026; v1 was Oct 2025.

title: The 2026 AI Index Report
key_claim: Industry produced over 90% of notable frontier models in 2025; world models — systems that predict what might happen in real-world environments — are highlighted as a frontier area, with World Labs cited as a notable spatial-AI developer.

title: How Physical AI Is Reshaping Robotics Today
key_claim: Physical AI (foundation-model-driven robotics trained increasingly in simulation) is moving from pilot into production deployment in 2026, reshaping robotics maturity across industrial verticals.

title: Global XR Shipments Rebound Behind Glasses-First Momentum
key_claim: MR/VR headset shipments expected to decline 42.8% in 2025, while XR glasses grow 211.2%; total XR shipments forecast 14.5M units in 2025 with smart glasses CAGR of 29.3% 2025-2029. Meta holds 75.7% Q3 2025 share.
notes: Structural anchor for the human-facing XR market collapse and glasses-first reorientation; 5+ months old but canonical for the headset-vs-glasses framing.

title: World Labs Raises $1 Billion to Scale Spatial AI
key_claim: World Labs raised $1B in February 2026 from AMD, Autodesk, Emerson Collective, Fidelity, NVIDIA and Sea, on top of its prior $230M; Marble launched November 2025 generates persistent 3D environments from text, images, video or layouts.
notes: Capital-flow anchor — direct evidence of where investors are putting money in the immersive-worlds space.

title: EssilorLuxottica Posts 11% Sales Jump, Extends AI Glasses Boost
key_claim: EssilorLuxottica Q1 2026 revenues up 10.8% at constant FX to €7.13bn, driven by AI glasses (Ray-Ban and Oakley smart models with Meta); North America +12.5%. EssilorLuxottica sold over 7M Meta AI frames in 2025, more than triple combined 2023-24 volumes.
notes: Tier 3 quality journalism — confirms commercial trajectory of human-facing smart glasses as the surviving immersive-worlds product line.

title: Headset hype meets harsh reality as Apple and Meta VR shipments fizzle in 2025
key_claim: Apple shipped only 45,000 Vision Pro units in 2025 (down ~345,000 YoY); Meta Quest shipments fell 16% YoY in Q1-Q3 2025; IDC's Francisco Jeronimo: 'All of these ideas that AR and VR would replace smartphones didn't happen. It will never happen.' Vision Pro digital ad spend fell >95% YoY across major markets.
notes: Tier 3 trade press; corroborates IDC structural anchor with named ad-spend cuts and IDC analyst quote.

title: NVIDIA and Global Robotics Leaders Take Physical AI to the Real World (GTC 2026, Cosmos 3 announcement)
key_claim: Jensen Huang at GTC 2026: 'every industrial company will become a robotics company'. NVIDIA announces Cosmos 3 (unifying synthetic world generation, vision reasoning and action simulation), Isaac Lab 3.0, GR00T N1.7 and previews GR00T N2 (DreamZero-based world-action-model architecture). Confirmed adopters include ABB, FANUC, KUKA, YASKAWA, Boston Dynamics, Figure, Agility, Skild AI and World Labs (using Isaac Sim to validate generative world models).
notes: Vendor source — directional. Used because it documents the platform-side capital and partner ecosystem; corroborated by Tier 1-2 sources for the underlying scientific and adoption claims.
